scope: Continuous bounded 16-bit VM ecology; aspirational universal prediction remains unattainable, not a success claim.

population.selection: two-way tournament on a fresh training process
population.replacement: random incumbent with Metropolis temperature 0.08; deleterious transitions permitted

inheritance: Mutable search bytecode produces edits; optional two-parent component crossover inherits predictor modules, router, search, dialect semantics and memory; fixed external VM ABI.
extinction: No surviving population: register a new episode with four founders. Each founder independently samples bounded FIFO diversity with probability 0.5, otherwise the registered ancestor mutation generator. Never rank founders by past fitness; never continue an extinct identity.
task_stream: SHA-256(master private seed, unbounded integer index), round-robin registered families constant/arithmetic/periodic/recurrence/switch/random. Fresh parameters at each attempt, 12 observed values and 12 one-step prequential trials. This is unbounded arrival, not a claim of unbounded family novelty.
feedback: Training accuracy only. No confirmed discoveries are claimed. Held-out capability study requires separately sealed seeds and a new analysis plan; family specialization is observable but not guaranteed.
recording: One SQLite FULL synchronous transaction commits compressed raw trials, lifecycle events, parent IDs, candidate genome, task commitment, cumulative fuel and exact PRNG/population checkpoint. Crash before commit re-executes the same transition; source or checkpoint corruption stops recovery.
retention: Last 1024 complete attempts retain raw trials. Older raw records are explicitly deleted after their event hashes are folded into a chronological SHA-256 root with a cumulative pruned count. State, private seed and immutable source remain for deterministic regeneration. Diversity FIFO eviction is a public event. Neither thinning nor archived diversity counts as confirmed progress.
disk_policy: SQLite capped 64MB including conservative rollback reserve. Project filesystem warning 80%, critical 90%; critical occupancy pauses new attempts without destroying history. Export remains independently available. No automatic deletion of public pilot archives.
recovery: Exact committed active population only; technical restart is distinct from recolonization. Bounded systemd restart rate and watchdog. No resurrection of best ancestors.
claims: Exploratory ecology. Infrastructure uptime, reproductive attempts and useful capabilities are separate. No guaranteed progress, language invention, generality, multi-year reliability or superiority is asserted.
